video_title: Voter Fatigue Will Affect SGA & Jokic’s MVP Odds | Chris Mannix & Evan Turner

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's potential to win MVP as a defensive standout
quotes.excerpt: I believe that the minutes shackles will be taken off him to a degree this year.
quotes.quote: Victor Wembanyama is taking over in San Antonio. He was the unanimous defensive player of the year last year. I think preseason predictions, a lot of them are going to have him as the overwhelming favorite to win the MVP with good reason. He almost won the MVP last year and he played less than 30 minutes per game. I believe that the minutes shackles will be taken off him to a degree this year. If he gets above 65 games and he is playing 35 minutes a game, he is going to get 25 and 13 with three blocks. He is going to be ridiculous.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's status as the overwhelming MVP favorite
quotes.excerpt: It'd be criminal if he doesn't win another MVP.

text_blocks.speaker: Evan Turner
text_blocks.text: I think he is the overwhelming favorite because every year you have him slated as the best defensive player. He is playing a full game. That is overwhelming once you realize last year he is averaging his numbers in under 30 minutes. Now you are throwing two and a half blocks, two steals, it is a full plate. It is like Jokic's numbers. It is hard to somewhat argue against it because he has done everything to a high level. Even to bring up Jokic, you cannot knock the level he pushes. It would be criminal if he does not win another MVP.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Mannix
text_blocks.text: Is that a behind the back pass? Unbelievable.

text_blocks.speaker: Evan Turner
text_blocks.text: When I sit there, I am like, man, this dude just keeps getting better. I thought before he was messed up, he went down and they won, and I thought Anthony Edwards was at a level balling, but I think that means they would have to win at a high level along with Luka Doncic. I think those two guys, if Luka finishes in the top four, maybe top three, averaging 35 like he did with his nine and eight, I do not see why not, especially after all the work he has done the past five or six years.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Matas Buzelis's impressive performance in preseason play
quotes.excerpt: He is up and down looking like mini Chet.
quotes.quote: Who is the kid from Michigan they drafted? Matas Buzelis. Oh my, I know I am overreacting to a preseason game, but what the hell? He is up and down looking like mini Chet. He is like mini Chet running the floor. It is like, oh my god, did they do it again? Did they do it again in Oklahoma City?

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins as key contributors for OKC
quotes.excerpt: I think Isaiah Joe is a candidate for sixth man. I think Aaron Wiggins is a most improved candidate.
quotes.quote: The guys that they peeled off, like Isaiah Joe, I think Isaiah Joe is a candidate for sixth man. I think Aaron Wiggins is a most improved candidate, because I think if he gets regular minutes in Atlanta, he is going to show out. He is a player.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Mitchell's development and potential in his third year
quotes.excerpt: In year three, AJ Mitchell is going to be balling out.
quotes.quote: AJ Mitchell, I was talking to him for a while, and he is from UC Santa Barbara. In year three, AJ Mitchell is going to be balling out.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Jeremy Sochan's development and the Spurs' team structure
quotes.excerpt: The worst thing that happened to Jeremy Sochan was he got hurt.
quotes.quote: The worst thing that happened to Jeremy Sochan was he got hurt, because he was throwing up 27, 20. Is that organization that good, or is that that many bad minds in the game? Because some of this stuff is no, they are great, but is it no, do you understand what I am saying? How are they this good running it off this much compared to everybody else who is supposed to be experts?

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: The front office strategy behind acquiring AJ Mitchell and Jaylen Williams
quotes.excerpt: They are not afraid to take on these guys that were mid-major guys.
quotes.quote: AJ Mitchell, they were on him for a while. He goes 38th to the Knicks, they make the trade for him. Mark Daigneault was telling me that we were on AJ Mitchell. Jaylen Williams, who went to Santa Clara, they are not afraid to take on these guys that were mid-major guys. Jaylen Williams is built like an NBA small forward.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Matt Maloney and Chris Herren's playing styles
quotes.excerpt: I remember he told me it's the baddest white boy walking.
quotes.quote: Matt Maloney, when you see Chris Herren from back in the day, he was euro stepping with the ball in his hands. Chris Herren was like the baddest white boy walking. I remember he told me in 08, he said this is the baddest white boy walking.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: The value of paying homegrown talent in the current CBA
quotes.excerpt: I would pay him $50 million a year.
quotes.quote: If you are a team, the Seattle expansion franchise for example, I would pay him $50 million a year. Otherwise, you run the risk. If you want to build a winning team, get that guy. One thing Oklahoma City would love, and this is something the players union would love too, is if they are trying to change the CBA, one thing they would love is to have the ability to not be penalized for paying homegrown talent. You can exceed the luxury tax. It is not a second apron penalty if you resign Lou Dort who you drafted years ago.

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul George's 2019 MVP-caliber season and Russell Westbrook's impact
quotes.excerpt: 2019 Paul George should have won MVP before he got hurt.
quotes.quote: 2019 Paul George should have won MVP before he got hurt. But I think he saw that team of Ben, shout out to Russell Westbrook for carrying it, but the finesse he did with just trading and getting all those picks for a done Paul George. You want to get him for year 11, be my guest.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.excerpt: He had that game in Miami, they played the night before in Houston.
quotes.quote: He had that game in Miami, they played the night before in Houston, it was an overtime game, I think, then they flew to Miami, got in at 4:00 in the morning, and he dropped 60 the next night. That to me was the best offensive game of the year. No disrespect to Bam Adebayo for the 80 plus, but that game, after with like 10 hours of sleep, to drop 60 in Miami in a game they needed to win, that was a start of a road trip they needed to do well on.
